verdict.rationale: The only explicit bulk capability in the evidence is importing users from a CSV (docs-20). Incident Workflows can apply one automated response to every matching incident, such as all P1/P2 incidents (docs-42), but that is rule-based automation rather than on-demand bulk action. The REST API and MCP server allow programmatic manipulation of account data (docs-32, docs-34), which could be scripted for bulk work, but nothing documents native batch endpoints. Missing for 10: documented bulk acknowledge/resolve/reassign of many incidents at once, batch API endpoints, bulk operations exposed via MCP for AI agents, and hands-on corroboration.
